lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.intro: These shelves once supplied half the coast. Now every road brings another excuse. Let us begin with enough magic to keep a worker alive.
variants.life: The growers left good roots in the ground. They need a safe place to work and someone to show that the next harvest will reach us.
variants.fire: The goblins charge the miners for entering their own workings. Coal is piling up behind three barricades. The toll ends today.
variants.water: Water is standing over the gathering beds, while the lower channels are dry. Mend the watercourse and the cutters can work again.
variants.earth: The potters have Clay and Peat. Their cart has been turned back twice. Bring them here alive, and every mixer in the village can start again.
variants.school: We have ingredients. We do not yet have enough people who can make anything with them. Help me teach three new hands.
variants.wind: The seed growers and reed cutters blame one another for ruined loads. Their harvests are good; their drying stations are not.
variants.magic: The refining apparatus leaks. I can mend its joints with a stabilizer, but the only clean binding agent comes from an intact cave-spider gland.
variants.death: One bitter shipment frightened the marsh gatherers away. Someone changed the labels, then spread the story that every Death Essence was poison.
variants.frost: The cold-storage works have stopped. The stock will spoil before another cart arrives unless we restore circulation and protect the workers.
variants.finale: Every route we reopened is being watched. They mean to burn the workshop and every shipment beside it. This time we have workers, supplies, and a plan.

lines.text: Let us put these shelves back to work.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.intro: Leave The True Note and walk to the coastal practice camp in Landfall. The quest marker is at (273, 124). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.life: Leave The True Note and find the Sage beds west of the city in Landfall. The quest marker is at (64, 249). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.fire: Leave The True Note and find the flint workings west of Landfall city. Start the raid there when ready. The quest marker is at (51, 216). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.water: Follow the Landfall coast to the sluice worksite marked on your map. The quest marker is at (279, 112). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.earth: Meet the potters at the loading point on the coastal road in Landfall. Load their cart there to begin the delivery. The quest marker is at (268, 128). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.school: Meet Mara, Tovin and Sela at the coastal teaching bench in Landfall. The quest marker is at (273, 124). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.wind: Walk to the coastal drying station in Landfall and meet the seed growers and reed cutters. The quest marker is at (270, 126). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.magic: Meet the refiners at the resin station on the Landfall coast. Begin the spider hunt there. The quest marker is at (273, 115). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.death: Meet the marsh gatherers at their southern collection station in Landfall. The quest marker is at (146, 382). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.frost: Meet the cold-storage workers at the coastal works in Landfall. The quest marker is at (279, 112). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.finale: Meet the trained crew at the coastal workshop receiving yard in Landfall. Begin the defense when your party is ready. The quest marker is at (273, 124). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.

lines.text: Check the supply ledger before setting out.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.intro: You can mend, aim, recover and mix. Now we can do more than ration what remains.
variants.life: The growers have a protected station and a buyer they can trust. There will be Life Essence on my shelf again.
variants.fire: No toll, no stolen loads. Coal and Flint can reach the mixers, and Fire Essence can reach the shelf.
variants.water: The channels run clear. The crew has its beds back, and our Water Essence supply has returned.
variants.earth: The potters' cart has arrived. This is what a supply line looks like: people reaching home with something useful.
variants.school: Three learners, three useful batches. The next shipment no longer depends on one tired pair of hands.
variants.wind: Dry seed, sound reeds, and people finally talking to one another. Wind Essence joins the shelf.
variants.magic: The apparatus holds a true note again. Keep this enriched essence as thanks; ordinary mixes still have their ordinary rare-result chances.
variants.death: A name is not a verdict. The marsh workers have a safe process, and Death Essence has an honest place on the shelf.
variants.frost: The cold holds, and the workers can promise a shipment instead of an apology. Frost Essence is available again.
variants.finale: Listen. Mortars, wheels, voices, and no empty shelves. We did not merely save a shipment. We taught this place how to keep going.

lines.text: This supply can be relied on again.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Listen to the problem before you choose the advice.

lines.speaker: Apprentice

variants.mara: I brought Sage and Reed. They look right, but I cannot make Life Essence.
variants.tovin: I have the right ingredients and tool. I skipped breakfast, and now I cannot keep mixing.
variants.sela: I used a bowl to crush the herbs. Surely any bowl works like a Mortar and Pestle?

lines.text: Can you help me find the mistake?

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: A successful mixture needs the right ingredients, a proper tool, and food. Try a real batch at your bench.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: And one enriched essence, from my own reserve. Choose the one that will serve your next journey.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: These shelves will stay open to you. Come back for supply contracts, and bring news of the roads.

lines.speaker: Mara Vale
lines.text: You made it. Let us put these supplies back on the road.

variants.intro:
Open Magic. Heal mends you; aim Heal Target at me. Restore Ether spends Water Essence; Fire Bolt needs a hostile target. Check each cast's cost.

Open Mixing, then Alchemy. Two Sage and one Hearthroot make Life Essence. Keep your Mortar and Pestle in your pack and eat first. The practice station provides safe injuries and replacement ingredients after a critical loss.

Complete all four casts and three Life Essence mixes, then report to Ilka at her shop.
variants.life:
Sage and Hearthroot make Life Essence: two Sage, one Hearthroot. Keep enough for your ten mixes; put the growers' share in the collection chest. Use the gatherers' caches for storage and mixing.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.fire:
A direct assault is quicker. The miners' side approach lets you silence their signal first. Both roads end with the workers owning their coal and flint again.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.water:
Work from the upper gate down. The bypass takes fewer repairs, but brings a smaller shipment. Kelp and Watercress make Water Essence; it fuels Restore Ether and joins Life Essence in Heal Target.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.earth:
Stay with the cart. It stops for enemies, damage, and anyone left behind. Heal Mara if she is hurt; repair the cart at a safe halt. Choose the main road for speed or the longer sheltered route.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.school:
Mara keeps choosing the wrong ingredients. Tovin's hands shake because he has not eaten. Sela borrowed a bowl and thought it would replace a Mortar and Pestle. Listen before you offer advice.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.wind:
Keep fresh reeds away from damp seed sacks. Repair the racks, set the vanes, and choose between a sheltered site and a larger exposed station.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.magic:
Track the spiders near the resin station. Damaged glands still teach us where to look; after twelve eligible specimens you will have a usable one. Mix the stabilizer, then make Magic Essence from Lotus and Resin.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.death:
Compare the labels with the samples. Toadstool and Thistle are useful when handled properly. We can inspect every batch, or follow the false labels back to the saboteurs.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.frost:
Set the intake first, then seal the containers. A trained villager will handle Frost production; your personal Frost mixing assignment opens at Potion level sixteen.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.finale:
Choose where the trained crew will stand. Hold the receiving yard, help the wounded, and stop their quartermaster before he reaches the workshop.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Take it with my thanks. The potters can bring their next shipment here safely now.

lines.text: This supply can be relied on again. Let us return to The True Note.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: These shelves once supplied half the coast, but now I cannot even keep enough stocked to supply our patrols. Could you help us re-establish our supply lines?

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Welcome back. Now put your fire magic to work along the next supply route. Gather 100 Coal and 50 Flint, then bring them here to mix Fire Essences. The workings are marked on your map. Take these pickaxes with you.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: One last practice batch: Water Essence, so our mages can recover ether. Gather 100 Kelp and 50 Watercress east in Reedfall, then bring them back to mix. I have marked both gathering beds on your map.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you for gathering the ingredients. Keep them in your pack: we will use them to mix the essences. Your harvesting reward is recorded.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: A sound practice batch. Here is your pay. Reliable shipments will let us fill these shelves again; first we must make the gathering routes safe.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: I am glad you were able to mix them. Please bring them to me in your inventory.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: You have made our first healing supplies. Before you take the longer road, learn how to use them. Find Ostrid Hollin at the temple; she will teach you to heal, strike with fire, and recover ether.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: First, mend your own wounds. Open Magic and choose Heal on yourself, or use its quickspell shortcut. It costs five ether and one Life Essence. I have given you practice supplies. Try it now; I will watch your cast.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Now tend an ally. I have a practice wound you can safely mend. Open Magic, choose Heal Target at power one and Cast, then click me. You can do this from Magic level zero. It costs five ether, one Life Essence and one Water Essence. Watch my health rise.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Now aim Fire Bolt at the practice dummy. Choose its individual-target version in Magic. One bolt costs five ether and one Fire Essence. Watch the target as you cast; your magic and its defenses decide the damage.

variants.ally_healed:
That helped. Heal Target is how you keep another person standing.

Now aim Fire Bolt at the practice dummy. Choose its individual-target version in Magic. One bolt costs five ether and one Fire Essence. Watch the target as you cast; your magic and its defenses decide the damage.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Your ether falls when you cast. Restore Ether, also called Gain Ether, spends one Water Essence to recover it over time. Try it on yourself now. Make room before using it in a fight: entering melee ends the recovery.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text:
Meet me in the sparring arena through the doorway on the right. Let's spar with magic to see what you have learned. Keep your health and ether up, and try to take me down with your fire bolt.

This is a private, nonlethal practice bout. I will stop if either of us falls. Talk to me to review the lesson or retry.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Steady yourself. There is no shame in practicing again. Keep your health up with Heal, strike me with Fire Bolt, and make room to recover ether. Talk to me when you are ready to try again.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Well done. You can heal, strike with fire, and recover ether. Take these essences for the road, then return to Ilka. She will help you put those lessons to use on the next supply run.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you. Let's mix these into life essences to provide to the guards defending our caravans. Open the mixing window and mix 25 life essences. Here are a few Potions of Feasting and mortar and pestles you can use.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Keep gathering the marked ingredients, or finish your 25 successful mixes. Bring your work back to me here at The True Note. Your quest instructions show your remaining tasks.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you. Let's mix these into fire essences to provide our mages with reagents for offensive magic. Open the mixing window and mix 25 fire essences. Here are a few Potions of Feasting and mortar and pestles you can use.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Keep gathering the marked ingredients, or finish your 25 successful mixes. Bring your work back to me here at The True Note. Your quest instructions show your remaining tasks.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you. Let's mix these into water essences to provide our mages with reagents for defensive magic. Open the mixing window and mix 25 water essences. Here are a few Potions of Feasting and mortar and pestles you can use.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Keep gathering the marked ingredients, or finish your 25 successful mixes. Bring your work back to me here at The True Note. Your quest instructions show your remaining tasks.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text:
Fenna, Sela, Nell and Ada have volunteered to bring in the herbs. Goblins from the Old Warren keep driving them off.

Will you guard them? We need 10,000 Sage and 5,000 Hearthroot. I have packed healing supplies for you. Meet the crew at the marked Sage beds when you are ready.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text:
We'll gather the Sage and carry full bags to that store. Watch the Old Warren approach; the goblins come south out of its mouth.

We need 10,000 Sage safely stored. If anyone falls, Heal Target will get her back up. We'll handle the harvest. You keep those goblins away.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: That's the Sage safely stored. The mixers can take it from here. Meet us at the marked Hearthroot beds next. We need 5,000 roots for the same number of essences.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: The Hearthroot beds are more exposed. The raiders still come from the Old Warren, west of here. Watch that approach while we gather the 5,000 roots.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: That is the last of the Hearthroot. Every goblin came from the same tunnels. Tell Ilka what we saw. A full store will not help if the next gathering crew cannot reach these beds.

measure.shelves.growers.report_crew.title: A trail back to the Warren

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: The herbs are safe, and the crew has earned a quiet evening. You have earned your pay too. But every raider came from the Old Warren. We must stop them at the source.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text:
Grask is an orc, with goblins and wolves at his heels. He's sending them out of the Old Warren to take our shipments.

Enter the mine west of town with your party. Follow the tracks into the deeper western caves and stop him. Then we can keep Life Essence on these shelves.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Goblin tracks, wolf prints, and heavy boots. Someone larger is directing these raids. The tunnels bend deeper to the west. We should keep an eye on the side caves.

lines.speaker: Grask, the Burrow-Taker
lines.text: Little harvesters, little guards. Every sack on that road belongs to Grask. You came all this way to become another missing shipment?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Your goblins will not touch the gathering crews again.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The raids end here. The crew can reach the beds again. We should tell Ilka the route is safe.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Fenna's crew can take the road again. Life Essence is back on the shelves, thanks to you. Now we can help people without wondering where the next handful of herbs will come from.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We were overwhelmed. We can regroup and try again, or leave for now. What should we do?

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.fire:
Brenna's people have been driven out of Blackcut. The Flint is there, but a goblin barricade stands between the crew and their work.

Will you help them? Take these supplies, then meet Brenna at the quarry west of town. She knows the ground.
variants.fire_coal:
The Flint is safe. Now Brenna needs help getting the Coal out of Lantern Mine. Most of it is already cut, but the lift ropes have been slashed.

Meet her at the marked Coal workings. Help her choose a hauling route and keep the workers safe.
variants.fire_sapper:
The cut ropes and powder traces point to Krek Cinderhook. He's preparing another attack from the service yard beside Blackcut.

Meet Brenna at the marked yard. Stop Krek before the next shift takes the road.

lines.text:
Brenna's people have been driven out of Blackcut. The Flint is there, but a goblin barricade stands between the crew and their work.

Will you help them? Take these supplies, then meet Brenna at the quarry west of town. She knows the ground.

lines.speaker: Brenna Flint
lines.text:
They've put a barricade between us and our own Flint. We can break it head-on, or slip round the side and cut the signal rope.

Once the guards are down, release the crew at the gate. We'll recover the cut stock and finish mining. Keep the hauling paths clear; Heal Target will get a fallen worker back up.

lines.speaker: Brenna Flint
lines.text:
Those cut ropes were no accident. Most of the Coal is ready; we only need a few more loads from the seam.

We can repair the lift in three protected steps, or brace the old passage and clear its spiders. Which route do you trust?

lines.speaker: Brenna Flint
lines.text:
Krek has powder enough to burn the workings. His signal brings reinforcements; cut it for a quieter fight. Open the water channels to weaken his blasts.

Light the powder fuse up close, or use Fire Bolt from a distance. Watch his blast marks and keep moving.

lines.speaker: Krek Cinderhook
lines.text: A quarry, a mine, and a shop full of little sparks. You think you can keep them all? I only need one good fire.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Your next load of powder ends here.

lines.speaker: You

variants.fire: The Flint shipment is secured. The crew can finish loading in peace. Ilka needs to hear about the stranded Coal next.
variants.fire_coal: That is the last Coal load secured. The cut ropes and powder traces point back toward Blackcut. We should report what the miners found.
variants.fire_sapper: Krek is finished. The quarry and mine can supply the shop again. We should return to Ilka with the news.

lines.text: The Flint shipment is secured. The crew can finish loading in peace. Ilka needs to hear about the stranded Coal next.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.fire: Five thousand Flint, safely secured. You have earned your pay, and the crew has its quarry back. Brenna’s Coal miners still need help below Lantern Mine.
variants.fire_coal: Ten thousand Coal and five thousand Flint. Enough ingredients for five thousand Fire Essences. But these attacks were organized. We need to stop the sapper preparing the next one.

lines.text: Five thousand Flint, safely secured. You have earned your pay, and the crew has its quarry back. Brenna’s Coal miners still need help below Lantern Mine.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: The quarry is working, and the Coal can reach us again. With Krek gone, that is a supply I can promise. Fire Essence is back on the shelves. Take this enriched essence with my thanks.

lines.speaker: Brenna Flint
lines.text: The loads we brought in are still safe. Take a breath, check the workers, and we'll finish this. If anyone is down, Heal Target will put them back on their feet.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We were overwhelmed. We can regroup at the last secured load or leave for now. Which shall we do?

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.water:
Flint and Coal are reaching us again. Now the coast has gone quiet. Veyra's people are charging the cutters to use their own water.

Take these supplies and meet Iona at the marked waterworks east of the city. Help her reopen the channels. We need a route nobody can hold to ransom.
variants.water_cutters:
The channels are open. Iona's crew can bring in the first 400 Kelp and 200 Watercress.

Meet them at the coastal landing. Guard the workers and the loading point while Ada hauls the bags. Once one gathering job is finished, those hands can help with the other.
variants.water_barge:
The cutters have done their part. Now we must get the shipment home.

Meet Iona and the barge at the coastal landing. She'll explain the two passages. I've packed Wood Planks for repairs; keep the crew and their cargo safe.
variants.water_keeper:
The shipment reached us, but the cutters will never be free while Veyra holds the upper gatehouse.

Meet Iona there. You can separate Veyra's guards with the gate controls, or face them together. Watch the water gathering at your feet and move before it strikes.

lines.text:
Flint and Coal are reaching us again. Now the coast has gone quiet. Veyra's people are charging the cutters to use their own water.

Take these supplies and meet Iona at the marked waterworks east of the city. Help her reopen the channels. We need a route nobody can hold to ransom.

lines.speaker: Iona Reed
lines.text:
Watercress needs fresh water; Kelp needs the tide. The keeper's marks show Fresh two, Tide one, Drain shut.

We can reset the gates and test the flow, or clear the six guards and break their diversion. Either way, this water belongs to the cutters.

lines.speaker: Iona Reed
lines.text:
Tamsin and I will cut Kelp. Nell will take the Watercress, and Ada will haul the bags. When one patch is finished, we'll help the others.

Tell us Work when you're ready. Regroup brings us to the landing; Wait holds us here. Watch Ada while she's carrying a load. Heal Target gets a fallen worker back up.

lines.speaker: Iona Reed
lines.text: That's the first load safe. The next beds are along the bank. We'll gather at the second landing; give the word when you want us to start again.

lines.speaker: Iona Reed
lines.text:
The sheltered channel has three obstructions, but the banks give us cover. The coastal passage is clearer, with more room for an ambush.

We'll take the towpath beside the boat. Give Ada the word to Sail, or Wait if we need to regroup. Which passage shall we take?

lines.speaker: Iona Reed
lines.text:
Veyra's north and south guards watch the controls. Close a gate and you'll shut two of them out of the fight, or you can take them all on.

Watch for water gathering under you. Her surges give you a moment to get clear. We'll keep the cutters back.

lines.speaker: Veyra Lockhand
lines.text: Every cutter, every boat, every little spark in that shop pays my toll. You have cost me three shipments. You will not cost me a fourth.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The cutters keep their harvest. Open the route, or we will.

lines.speaker: You

variants.water: Fresh water reaches the Watercress, and tidal water reaches the Kelp. I should tell Ilka that the crew can begin.
variants.water_cutters: The Kelp and Watercress shipment is secured. I should return to Ilka before we launch the boat.
variants.water_barge: The cargo has reached the final landing. The ambushers’ orders point to Veyra at the upper gatehouse. Ilka needs to hear this.
variants.water_keeper: Veyra is defeated and the gate controls are free. Iona can reopen the route. I should return to Ilka to restore Water Essence stock.

lines.text: Fresh water reaches the Watercress, and tidal water reaches the Kelp. I should tell Ilka that the crew can begin.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.water: Both beds have water again. Here is your pay. Now let us put Iona’s cutters back to work.
variants.water_cutters: Four hundred Kelp and two hundred Watercress, safely secured. You have earned your pay. Now we need a boat and a safe passage for the shipment.
variants.water_barge: The cargo arrived, but those orders explain why the attacks keep coming. Take your reward. We must deal with the keeper of that toll.

lines.text: Both beds have water again. Here is your pay. Now let us put Iona’s cutters back to work.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text:
The cutters have their water, the boat has its passage, and Veyra has lost her toll. I can keep Water Essence on the shelves again.

Take your pay and this enriched essence. Keep those orders too. Someone wanted these routes broken; I want to know who.

lines.speaker: Iona Reed
lines.text: We haven't lost the work we finished. Take a breath and check on the crew. Anyone still down needs Heal Target. Then give the word, and we'll carry on.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can regroup and try again, or withdraw and come back prepared. What shall we do?

lines.speaker: Iona Reed
lines.text: The toll is finished. Both gates are open. Tamsin, Nell, Ada — take the cutters through. We can use our own water again.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The route is open and the cutters are passing freely. I should tell Ilka that Water Essence supplies can resume.
